lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill region, extending toward the caudal peduncle, though spatial positioning is periodically distorted by surface light refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a localized grid pattern where high-luminance blobs frequently occupy the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity superior edge and a lower-intensity inferior shadow, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low density of small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs is visible, primarily concentrated within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic network patterns from surface water refraction are projected across the dorsal and lateral surfaces; a remora is visible near the posterior-ventral margin of the right pectoral fin.
